messages.content: Tell me some of the major airports in the United States.

message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, sorted roughly by passenger traffic (largest to smaller but still significant):

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport by passenger traffic in the world; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and Latin America; one of the busiest airports on the West Coast. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the oldest major hubs; serves as a key connecting point for many airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Large hub for American Airlines; one of the largest airports by land area. |
| Denver International Airport | Denver, CO | DEN | Known for its distinctive peaked roof; major hub for United Airlines and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City, NY | JFK | Major international gateway; primary hub for many carriers including Delta and JetBlue. |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Key hub for flights to Asia and the Pacific Rim; known for its efficient layout. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle, WA | SEA | Major hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for other carriers. |
| Miami International Airport | Miami, FL | MIA | Major gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean; hub for American Airlines. |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando, FL | ORL | Major hub for leisure travelers; primary base for Southwest Airlines. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Major hub for American Airlines; high volume of domestic flights. |
| George Bush Intercontinental Airport | Houston, TX | IAH | Major hub for United Airlines; one of the busiest airports in Texas. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports in the U.S. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport | Dulles, VA | IAD | Major hub for United Airlines; serves the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | Newark, NJ | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; close proximity to New York City. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport | Detroit, MI | DTW | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; one of the largest airports in the Midwest. |
| Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport | Minneapolis–St. Paul, MN | MSP | Major hub for United Airlines; known for its efficient operations. |
| Boston Logan International Airport | Boston, MA | BOS | Major hub for Boston‑based airlines like JetBlue; important for Northeast Corridor travel. |
| Philadelphia International Airport | Philadelphia, PA | PHL | Major hub for American Airlines; serves the Mid-Atlantic region. |
| Salt Lake City International Airport | Salt Lake City, UT | SLC | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; known for its quick turnaround times. |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger numbers, flight movements, or both, and they serve as major hubs for several major U.S. carriers.
